image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a single daisy flower in focus against a blurred green background. The flower features a bright yellow central disc composed of tiny florets and a ring of white ray petals that appear slightly translucent with a hint of lavender/blue tint at the tips. A slender green stem is visible supporting the flower head, extending downwards into the out-of-focus foliage.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The petals exhibit an unusual semi-translucent, plastic-like sheen and a slight purplish/lavender color cast at the tips, which deviates from the typical opaque white of a common daisy. This suggests potential AI generation artifacts in material rendering.

The background blur is very smooth and uniform, lacking the natural bokeh characteristics of a lens. It resembles Gaussian smoothing often seen in AI images, though it could also be aggressive post-processing.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the specific morphological features (petal shape, center texture) align with the 'daisy' class or if it resembles a different asteraceae species due to AI hallucination.
To analyze the unnatural translucency and color shift in the petals for signs of generative artifacts.
To check for edge bleeding between the petals and the background, ensuring the flower is a coherent object.

focus_areas: Petal texture and opacity (checking for plastic/melting look)
Color consistency of petals (white vs. lavender tint)

Granular detail of the yellow center
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the petal material properties. Real daisies are opaque; these look slightly glassy or plastic. Determine if this is a stylistic choice, a lighting effect, or an AI artifact. Also, verify if the purple tint is a known variety trait or a color bleeding artifact.
